title: Avro Lancaster PD431
memorial_details:
A wall mounted brushed metal plate with inscription and detail incised in black. The badges of the Royal Air Force and the Royal Australian Air Force are placed either side at the top, with the inscription and names below.

The inscription is located in a community setting, indicating local significance.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ THE CREW WHO DIED WHEN/ RAF LANCASTER PD431 OF 1653 HCU/ CRASHED & CAUGHT FIRE 100 YDS EAST (Arrow) OF THIS SPOT/ 4.00 PM SUNDAY MARCH 4th 1945/ ---------- O ----------/ (Names)/ ---------- O ----------/ LEST WE FORGET
